entity.name: Devansh Varshney
entity.description: Devansh Varshney is the creator and maintainer of FilterTube, a free and open-source, local-first content filtering project focused on giving users direct control over their viewing experience. FilterTube is developed with a particular focus on attention management, parental controls, privacy, accessibility, and support for families and neurodivergent users. Development includes browser extensions and mobile applications, with work extending to Android TV and iOS/iPadOS.

projects.name: FilterTube
projects.description: FilterTube is a free and open-source, local-first content filtering project that lets users control what appears on supported video platforms through blocklists, allowlists, keyword and channel rules, content controls, profiles, and parental protections. FilterTube is designed to keep filtering decisions under the user's control and to minimize reliance on FilterTube-operated services or accounts. The project includes browser extensions and an Android application, with Android TV and iOS/iPadOS support under development.

channels.description: Support the ongoing development and maintenance of FilterTube with a one-time or monthly contribution.

plans.name: Twelve-month FilterTube development grant
plans.description: A $10,000 institutional grant will fund twelve months of focused work on FilterTube. Milestones are: improve reliable filtering and admission enforcement across supported browser and embedded playback surfaces; advance Android phone, tablet, and TV usability and release quality; advance iOS and iPadOS toward public release while preserving feature parity; expand automated regression, accessibility, and performance testing; strengthen privacy, parental-control, user documentation, and reproducible release processes; and publish periodic progress updates with completed work, test evidence, releases, and remaining risks. Funding primarily supports maintainer time, test devices, distribution accounts, and essential project infrastructure. Scope and milestone reporting can be agreed with the funder before disbursement.
